purpose: Author-created moving-launcher assimilation routine for M2D-SBA-23. This is not the exact Q15 H1/H2/H3 ladder and cannot release Q15 while source audit is blocked.

transfer_routines.title: Convert the launch into the ground frame, then use projectile motion
recognition_signals: the launch source or platform is moving relative to the ground
the launch velocity is stated relative to the moving source
the requested motion is described in a different frame

method_steps.title: Name the frame
method_steps.learner_move: Label every given velocity by object and reference frame.

method_steps.title: Convert the launch velocity
method_steps.learner_move: Use vector addition to obtain the object's launch velocity in the requested inertial frame.

method_steps.title: Resolve the converted launch vector
method_steps.learner_move: Find the horizontal and vertical components in that same frame.

method_steps.title: Run the projectile clock
method_steps.learner_move: Use the converted components with one elapsed time and gravity, keeping all quantities in one frame.

independent_practice.prompt: A trolley moves east at 6 m/s. A ball is projected at 10 m/s relative to the trolley, 37 degrees above east. Using sin 37 degrees = 0.6 and cos 37 degrees = 0.8, find the initial ground-frame velocity components.
independent_practice.answer_check: Relative components are (8,6) m/s; adding trolley velocity (6,0) m/s gives ground-frame components (14,6) m/s.

hint_ladder.label: Practice clue
hint_ladder.prompt: First decide which velocities are relative to the trolley and which are relative to the ground.

hint_ladder.label: Practice representation
hint_ladder.prompt: Draw v_ball,ground = v_ball,trolley + v_trolley,ground before resolving the final vector.

hint_ladder.label: Practice first move
hint_ladder.prompt: Resolve the 10 m/s relative launch into (8,6) m/s, then add the trolley's horizontal velocity.

readiness_checks: identify object and reference frame for every velocity
perform vector frame conversion before projectile kinematics
obtain ground-frame u_x and u_y without H2/H3
check the zero-platform-speed limit and keep one frame throughout
transfer_routines.release_rule: This routine may establish generated-practice readiness only. Hold Q15 until the exact repository-backed Q15 prompt, solution and source H1/H2/H3 ladder are audited and pre-taught.
